issue_request: FHIR-7126 was a Published FHIR-core Procedure change request with a Not Persuasive with Modification resolution. The work group declined to make Procedure.complication narrative-only and instead agreed to add usage guidance that text-only complications can be sent using CodeableConcept.text.
initial_application: Commit 512b2462e336c8a6425e2f3dc1a8590403e6e39b explicitly included #7126 and added the Procedure.complication usage note to the old Procedure spreadsheet source. The current source has since moved to source/procedure/structuredefinition-Procedure.xml.
additional_context: Procedure is active in the current build via source/fhir.ini. Later Published issue FHIR-32511 merged Procedure.complication and Procedure.complicationDetail by changing Procedure.complication to CodeableReference(Condition), and commit 0e1ea923399d5bc6f2fdefb6b09e4073674d04fc updated the note from CodeableConcept.text to CodeableReference.concept.text. FHIR-47824 later added isSummary to the same element without changing the text-only guidance. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current Procedure.complication comment already says text-only complications can be captured using CodeableReference.concept.text, which is the current datatype-equivalent form of the FHIR-7126 resolution.
